Outsider · SM +0 Shadow Mastiff (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5)

A black hound the size of a mastiff, hard to make out in anything but full daylight, hunting in packs. The baying is the danger: it gets into the nerve and scatters a group, which is precisely what the pack is waiting for.

BayWhen a creature (except evil outsiders) hears the howl of a shadow mastiff, it must roll an immediate Fright Check. If a victim succeeds at his Fright Check, he will be unaffected by this ability for one hour.———
